segments.thag4.12:3.1: “Nāsissaṃ na pivissāmi, vihārā ca na nikkhame;
segments.thag4.12:4.3: Tisso vijjā anuppattā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan”ti.
segments.thag4.12:5.1: Nāgasamālo bhagu ca, sabhiyo nandakopi ca;
segments.thag4.12:5.3: Jambuko senako thero, sambhūto rāhulopi ca.
segments.thag4.12:6.1: Bhavati candano thero, dasete [idāni naveva therā dissanti] buddhasāvakā;
segments.thag4.12:6.3: Dhammiko sappako thero, mudito cāpi te tayo;
segments.thag4.12:6.5: Gāthāyo dve ca paññāsa, therā sabbepi terasāti [idāni dvādaseva therā dissanti].
